text: The purpose of this motion is to temporarily extend the peak-hour parking restrictions on portions of Queen Street West and Shaw Street to facilitate effective movement of over 106, 000 TTC customers per day on its vital 504 King, 508 Lake Shore and 501 Queen streetcar routes (and all roadway users), during the King Street West Watermain and Track Renewal construction works. Transit service delays in the range of 25 percent to 45 percent on these streetcar routes are projected without extensions to peak hour parking restrictions. Starting February 2024 to December 2024, the City of Toronto’s contractor will begin replacing a watermain and renewing the streetcar tracks (with TTC) on King Street West between Dufferin Street and Shaw Street.
